verdict.rationale: Heap is a product analytics platform with an AI assistant (Sense Chat), so letting it connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can register or consume MCP servers or their tools. The docs cover tracking snippets, event and identity APIs, session replay, and pricing, and none of that is about MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
